item.title: Hyderabad Toofans Beat HIL GC 4-3 to Finish Third in Hockey India League 2026
item.description: Hyderabad Toofans clinched third place in the Hockey India League 2026 with a thrilling 4-3 win over HIL GC in Bhubaneswar, as Amandeep Lakra starred with a brace.

item.title: Sri Lanka’s Unbeaten Home ODI Run Faces Test as England, Root Set Up Series Decider
item.description: Sri Lanka’s five-year unbeaten home ODI series record is under threat as England level the series 1-1, with Joe Root emerging once again as the key challenge in the decider.

item.title: Vedanta Kalinga Lancers Beat Ranchi Royals 3-2 to Win Men’s Hockey India League Title
item.description: Vedanta Kalinga Lancers clinched the Men’s Hockey India League title with a thrilling 3-2 win over Ranchi Royals in Bhubaneswar, as Alexander Hendrickx starred in the final.

item.title: BBL: Maxwell Re-signs With Melbourne Stars For Another Two Years
item.description: T20 High Performance Manager: Australian star allrounder Glenn Maxwell has re- signed with Melbourne Stars with another two years, the Big Bash League (BBL) club said on Tuesday.

item.title: PWL 2026: Punjab Royals Surge To Commanding 4–1 Lead At Halfway Mark Against Maharashtra Kesari
item.description: Asian Wrestling Champion Chandermohan: Punjab Royals produced a dominant opening-half performance to take a 4–1 lead against Maharashtra Kesari at the midway stage of Match 12 of the Pro Wrestling League 2026, being played at the Noida Indoor Stadium in Noida on Monday.

item.title: When Sunil Gavaskar Took on the BCCI: The NCA Power Struggle That Shook Indian Cricket
item.description: Twenty-five years ago, Sunil Gavaskar challenged BCCI authority over the functioning of the National Cricket Academy, leading to resignations, public fallout, and a rare moment of open dissent in Indian cricket.

item.title: Australian Open: Sinner Snuffs Out Late Darderi Push To Reach Quarters; Djokovic, Swiatek, Musetti Too Advance (round-up)
item.description: Italian Luciano Darderi: Jannik Sinner overcame a few difficult moments but ultimately asserted his authority to defeat fellow Italian Luciano Darderi 6-1, 6-3, 7-6(2) and moved into the men's singles quarterfinals of the Australian Open in Melbourne on Monday.

item.title: 'No Better Time To Start Coming Up Against Strong Teams,’ Says Captain Oliver Peake As Aus U19 Inch Closer To SF
item.description: U19 World Cup: Australia U19 captain Oliver Peake believes his side’s unbeaten run has set them up perfectly to strike at the business end of the U19 World Cup, declaring there is “no better time” for his young squad to test themselves against the tournament’s heavyweights.

item.title: Sabalenka Storms Into Fourth Straight Australian Open Semifinal With Win Over Jovic
item.description: World No. 1 Aryna Sabalenka crushed 18-year-old American Iva Jovic 6-3, 6-0 to reach her fourth consecutive Australian Open semifinal, remaining the only former champion left in the women’s draw.

item.title: Aussie Pacer Kane Richardson Retires From Professional Cricket
item.description: T20 World Cup: Australian fast bowler Kane Richardson has called time on his professional cricket career, drawing the curtain on a 17-year journey that spanned international success, domestic titles and franchise leagues around the world.
